'''Kasey''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cell in [[Byrne City]] on the planet [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] when she met [[Enid Vahr]] and fell in love. He convinced her to join the Alliance.<ref name="BE" />
